title: Raw-error leak: the underlying raw text surfaced as the twin primary message, where an UNSTRUCTURED twin preserves it in received

violation.message: the twin surfaced the underlying raw error text as its primary reason; an un-cataloged failure is UNSTRUCTURED with the raw text preserved verbatim in received, never handed back as the answer

raw_error: Sort exceeded memory limit of 33554432 bytes

steps.step: An operation fails with something the corpus has no entry for. The twin is honestly marked UNSTRUCTURED and then hands the agent the raw text as the answer, instead of stating the situation and preserving the raw text where it belongs.
